name: Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan
nameAr: يحيى بن سعيد بن فروخ التميمي القطان البصري
mawla: said to be a client of Banu Tamim (Tahdhib al-Kamal)
bornNote: 'I was born at the start of 120' (his own words, via Amr ibn Ali; Tahdhib al-Tahdhib).
diedNote: Safar 198 AH, aged seventy-eight (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib; Taqrib).

taqrib.ar: ثقة متقن حافظ إمام قدوة من كبار التاسعة، مات سنة ثمان وتسعين ومائة وله ثمان وسبعون
taqrib.en: Reliable, precise, a hadith master, an imam and exemplar; among the senior men of the ninth generation; died in 198 aged seventy-eight.

role: Founder of narrator criticism in Iraq; teacher of Ahmad, Ibn Ma'in and Ibn al-Madini

teachers.name: Hammad ibn Zayd
teachers.source: Tahdhib al-Tahdhib, entry on Hammad ibn Zayd (students: 'al-Qattan')

teachers.name: Sulayman ibn Harb
teachers.source: al-Dhahabi, Siyar, entry on Sulayman ibn Harb: 'among the earlier men who narrated from him, Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan'

teachers.name: Shu'bah ibn al-Hajjaj
teachers.source: Tahdhib al-Tahdhib: 'I frequented Shu'bah for twenty years'

students.name: Muhammad ibn Bashshar (Bundar)
students.source: Tahdhib al-Tahdhib; Jami' al-Tirmidhi 1925 (Bundar → Yahya → Isma'il → Qays → Jarir)

verdicts.ar: حدثني يحيى القطان وما رأت عيناي مثله
verdicts.en: Yahya al-Qattan narrated to me, and my eyes never saw his like.

verdicts.ar: كان إليه المنتهى في التثبت بالبصرة
verdicts.en: In Basra, verification reached its limit in him.

verdicts.ar: ما رأيت أثبت من يحيى القطان
verdicts.en: I never saw anyone firmer than Yahya al-Qattan.

verdicts.ar: ما رأيت أعلم بالرجال من يحيى القطان، ولا رأيت أعلم بصواب الحديث والخطأ من ابن مهدي
verdicts.en: I never saw anyone more knowledgeable of narrators than Yahya al-Qattan, nor anyone more knowledgeable of what is correct and mistaken in hadith than Ibn Mahdi.
Your eyes will not see his like.

verdicts.ar: حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد إمام أهل زمانه
verdicts.en: Yahya ibn Sa'id, the imam of the people of his age, narrated to us.
He was reliable, trustworthy, of high standing, a proof.

verdicts.ar: بصري ثقة في الحديث، كان لا يحدث إلا عن ثقة
verdicts.en: A Basran, reliable in hadith; he narrated only from reliable men.
He was among the reliable hadith masters.

verdicts.ar: هو إمام بلا مدافعة، وهو أجل أصحاب مالك بالبصرة، وكان الثوري يتعجب من حفظه، واحتج به الأئمة كلهم وقالوا: من تركه يحيى تركناه
verdicts.en: He is an imam beyond dispute, the most eminent of Malik's students in Basra; al-Thawri marvelled at his memory; all the imams relied on him and said: whomever Yahya abandoned, we abandon.

verdicts.ar: كان من سادات أهل زمانه حفظا وورعا وفهما وفضلا ودينا وعلما، وهو الذي مهد لأهل العراق رسم الحديث وأمعن في البحث عن الثقات وترك الضعفاء
verdicts.en: He was among the masters of his age in memory, scrupulousness, understanding, merit, religion and learning; it was he who laid down for the people of Iraq the method of hadith, searched deeply into who was reliable and left the weak.
verdicts.source: al-Thiqat 7/611 (Ibn Hajar notes Ibn Manjuwayh copied these words from Ibn Hibban without attribution); Tahdhib al-Tahdhib

bio: The Basran master who, with Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi, set the standard of narrator criticism that Ahmad, Ibn Ma'in and Ibn al-Madini inherited: Ibn Hibban says he laid down the method of hadith for Iraq. He frequented Shu'bah for twenty years and was the arbiter Shu'bah's students chose when they disputed. He narrated only from reliable men, and the scholars said that whomever Yahya left they left. Born at the start of 120, he died in Safar 198. Not to be confused with Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, the Madinan judge, from whom he also narrates.
